newsitem.title: USA: Centocor, GenPharm in research pact.
newsitem.headline: Centocor, GenPharm in research pact.

text.p: GenPharm International Inc said on Monday it signed a research and commercialization agreement with Centocor Inc regarding GenPharm's transgenic mouse strain.
The collaboration focuses on developing human antibodies to several antigens, GenPharm said. It said its HuMAb-Mouse strain contains functional human antibody genes.
Payments to GenPharm could total $57 million, the company said. In addition, Centocor would pay royalties to GenPharm on any products resulting from the collaboration, it said.
Centocor would get worldwide marketing and manufacturing rights to any antibodies that entered the clinic.
In turn, GenPharm said it would receive research and benchmark payments depending on the success of the program, as well as two equity investments.
GenPharm's transgenic mouse strain enabled high affinity completely human antibodies to be generated against a wide range of antigens, including human antigens, it said.
